content: {"like":["Adored the Carry On movies and enjoyed the collection as a whole","Favorite actor Kenneth Williams and appreciated his presence in most films","Enjoyed the humorous takes on historical and contemporary themes in films like Don’t Lose Your Head, Up The Khyber, and Follow That Camel","Liked the ensemble of regular actors such as Kenneth Connor, Charles Hawtrey, Sid James, Frankie Howard, Joan Sims, Hattie Jacques, Jim Dale, Angela Douglas, Liz Fraser, Barbara Windsor, and Bernard Bresslaw","Appreciated the double entendres and creative use of the English language in the films"],"dislike":["Found Carry On Columbus to be the worst in the series","Criticized Carry On England for lacking creativity and storyline","Mentioned that Carry On Emmanuele was not as bad as critics claimed but implied it was still less favorable"]}
